newsitem.title: USA: Excite Inc to offer 2.3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Excite Inc to offer 2.3 mln shares.

text.p: Excite Inc said Friday it plans to offer about 2.3 million shares of its common stock.
The offering will include only shares sold by the company.
Excite, based in Mountain View, California, said it plans to file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission during the week of March 3.
It said net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including possibly the acquisition of products and businesses and technologies or distribution arrangements.
